definitions.explanation: Wine made from dark-skinned grape varieties, producing a red or deep purple color. One of the three main categories of wine alongside white wine and rosé.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ワインをグラスで{一杯|いっぱい}。
examples.english: One glass of red wine, please.

examples.japanese: {肉料理|にくりょうり}には{赤|あか}ワインが{合|あ}う。
examples.english: Red wine goes well with meat dishes.

examples.japanese: フランス{産|さん}の{赤|あか}ワインをお{土産|みやげ}に{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I bought a French red wine as a souvenir.

notes:
{赤|あか}ワイン is composed of {赤|あか} (red) + ワイン (wine). A straightforward compound.

WINE TYPES:
- {赤|あか}ワイン: red wine
- {白|しろ}ワイン: white wine
- ロゼ(ワイン): rosé wine
- スパークリングワイン: sparkling wine

ORDERING SHORTHAND:
In restaurants, {赤|あか} alone can be used as shorthand: {赤|あか}をください (a red, please).

COOKING USES:
- {赤|あか}ワイン{煮|に}: braised in red wine
- {赤|あか}ワインソース: red wine sauce
- {赤|あか}ワイン{煮込|にこ}み: red wine stew

ALTERNATE NAME:
{赤|あか}ぶどう{酒|しゅ} is a more literary/traditional equivalent, but {赤|あか}ワイン is standard.
